ns2:course.label: Special Topics Mol Cell Biol
ns2:course.description: Discussion of current topics of interest within the broad domain of molecular and cellular biology; seminar or lecture format. Topics vary. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing and consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing and consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Biochemistry or Molecular and Cellular Biology major(s).
